name: QUEUE-OWED-pump-builds-the-head
note: The pump starts on the queue's head whatever the stream holds: a pixel let go by the frame's crossing before the pump's turn is built whole and thrown away, while the grid round the traveller waits - the report. (PIN MOVED, STREAM-OWED: re-aimed by content at the pump's take.)

name: QUEUE-OWED-books-unread
note: The take drops nothing the stream let go: every queued pixel is built, let go or not (the pump as it was). (PIN MOVED, STREAM-OWED: owes() is takeOwed now.)

name: QUEUE-OWED-the-whole-queue-dropped
note: A let-go pixel takes the owed pixels queued behind it with it: the grid's new edge is never built.

name: QUEUE-OWED-let-go-dropped-at-the-head-alone
note: Only the let-go pixels ahead of the first owed one are dropped (owes() as it shipped): one behind it stays on the queue, and taken nearest is built for nobody. Replaces QUEUE-OWED-one-let-go-dropped-a-turn - takeOwed drops in one pass and has no turns.
